title: Constant-scalar presentation of a single proper counit projection
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, p:X→Y any scheme morphism, aX and aY presentations of unbounded intrinsic derived tensor by signed total tensor on flat-term K-flat complexes [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and K in D(X_proet,R), L in D(Y_proet,R) arbitrary [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let EX and EY be the canonical derived associated-module-sheaf equivalences from fixed-R module-valued sheaves to intrinsic constant-ring modules. The intrinsic proper-factor projection, adjunct to tensor pullback followed by counit tensor identity, is isomorphic as an arrow to EY of the published fixed-R proper-factor projection evaluated on EX.inverse(K) and EY.inverse(L). No open immersion, compactification, operation datum, constructibility, Tor bound, or projection invertibility is assumed.

source.place: Tags 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product) and 07A6 (lemma-adjoint); constant-scalar specialization of the proper transpose step of lem-sf-finite-projection-operation-presentation

proof.text: Construct finiteScalarPullbackComparison by the inverse mate of the normalized derived direct-image comparison. The two intrinsic direct-image functors agree by the coefficient adjunction Hom bijection. Inverse-mate invertibility along the realization equivalences proves that the pullback comparison is an isomorphism, without any projection invertibility assumption.

Apply finiteScalarTensorPullbackComparison to the supplied aX and aY. It provides the two tensor bifunctor isomorphisms and ComparisonCompatible for the published fixed-scalar and canonical intrinsic tensor-pullback maps.

Apply the existing categorical map_rightAdjointProjectionMap_comp_mateEquiv theorem. The mate is invertible along the realization equivalences. Its two endpoint composites, formed from the tensor comparisons, mate and pullback comparison, are isomorphisms. Arrow.isoMk packages the resulting commuting projection square as projectionArrowIso.

Evaluate at the inverse realizations of K and L. Naturality of the intrinsic projection transformation at the two realization counit isomorphisms gives an arrow isomorphism from these realized inputs to K,L themselves. Compose it with projectionArrowIso and reverse the result. Unfolding the curried comparison identifies its component with finiteScalarProperProjection.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A4 and 07A6; U6 uses the existing categorical projection/mate identity and proves the arrow/counit assembly. Only the tensor-pullback square is split off.

theorem finiteScalarProperProjection_presentation
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (proEtaleConstantRing X R))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y R))
    (K : proEtaleDerivedCategory X R) (L : proEtaleDerivedCategory Y R) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk (finiteScalarProperProjection R p aX aY K L) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).functor.map
        (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p).app
            ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).inverse.obj K)).app
              ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).inverse.obj L))))
